statement: At the owner's explicit request, this present-day signature acknowledges the listed versions as part of Sherman Gaucia Laing's published research and contribution record, including retained mistakes, corrections and third-party attribution. The signature applies to the exact bytes of this manifest.
scope: Pinned main histories of the research and Bible repositories; unique contribution commits on every observed non-main branch of the four listed forks. Fork main baselines are references only, not claimed owner-authored work.
not_asserted: Independent proof of original creation dates
Exclusive ownership of upstream code or public mathematics
Upstream acceptance, endorsement, merger or payment
Coverage of private, deleted or otherwise unlisted publications
date_semantics: Git author/committer dates are recorded metadata. The detached OpenPGP signature records the actual signing time. This attestation does not backdate authentication.
rights: Existing repository license and all applicable third-party notices remain unchanged. Signing a reference does not relicense its contents.
verification_scope: GitHub API signature observations, complete parent closure of the two main histories, and reconstructed SHA-1 identities of every tree in the two current snapshots. Previously verified blob bodies and scientific tests were not rerun.
